verdict.rationale: uv documents a concrete import path for pip users: 'uv add -r' to migrate a requirements.txt file (uv-docs-42), plus a full pip-compatible 'uv pip' CLI and drop-in replacement for pip/pip-tools/virtualenv/poetry/pyenv (uv-docs-4, uv-docs-5, uv-docs-31, uv-docs-66) that reduces friction for switchers. However, there is no documented converter for other incumbents' native files (e.g., poetry.lock, Pipfile, pyproject build backends), and community reports cite real migration friction (missing --user flag, sticky --no-binary, Docker/venv location differences) showing the transition isn't seamless. Missing for 10: dedicated import/conversion command for Poetry/Pipenv projects, independent hands-on account of a full incumbent-to-uv migration succeeding without workarounds.
